ja: 歴代ＢＢ戦士の中で絶大な人気を誇る武者號斗丸、最新‘ＬＥＧＥＮＤＢＢ’シリーズより 『武者號斗丸“最終決戦Ver.”』現る！！
『 闘志の激しきこと炎の如く、心の澄みわたること水の如し、これこそ“炎水の境地”なりィ 』
最終決戦時の形態を、金銀メッキ、新規造形で熱く再現! 豪華仕様の號斗丸決定版!!
“新爆熱の陣”を徹底再現！！
●石破天驚剣が付属!!
石破天驚剣が新規造形で付属。銀メッキを施し、存在感のある仕上がり。柄頭は緑のクリアパーツで再現。
●石破天驚剣、天の神具、天光の証、鳳凰の紋を新規パーツで再現! 金銀メッキとクリア成形素材で豪華な仕上がり！
全長110ｍｍ大型の剣・石破天驚剣、胸・胴部の天の神具、交流角の上に現れる天光の証、肩の鳳凰の紋を新規造形で再現し、
銀や金のメッキで仕上げ。細部再現用のホイルシールが付属。天の神具、天光の証の中央にはクリア成形パーツを使用。
●武者形態、スーパーモード『爆熱の陣』もゴージャスに仕上がる!
通常の角飾り、爆熱甲などの各所にも新たに金メッキを使用。
ノンスケール組み立て式プラモデル
対象年齢：15才以上

en: Musha Gotomaru, who is extremely popular among all the BB warriors of all time, is now available as “Musha Gotomaru “Final Battle Ver.” from the latest ‘LEGENDBB’ series! !
``A fierce fighting spirit is like fire, and a pure heart is like water; this is the state of ``flaming water.''
The form at the time of the final battle is passionately reproduced with gold and silver plating and new modeling! Definitive version of Gotomaru with luxurious specifications!!
Thoroughly reproduce the “new explosive camp”! !
-Ishiba Tenkyou sword included!!
Ishiba Tenkyouken is included with a new model. Silver plated for a strong presence. The pommel is reproduced with green clear parts.
-Reproduce the Ishiba Tenkyou Sword, Heaven's Divine Tools, Tenko's Proof, and Phoenix Crest with new parts! Luxurious finish with gold and silver plating and clear molding material!

A large sword with a total length of 110mm, Ishiba Tenkyouken, the sacred tools of heaven on the chest and torso, the proof of heavenly light that appears above the exchange horn, and the phoenix crest on the shoulder are reproduced with new modeling,
Finished with silver or gold plating. A foil seal is included for detail reproduction. A clear molded part is used in the center of the heavenly sacred tool, the proof of heavenly light.
●The warrior mode and super mode “Bakunetsu no Jin” are also gorgeous!
New gold plating is also used in various places such as the usual corner ornaments and the explosive shell.
Non-Scale Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
